description: Adds the AWS SDK for PHP so Tiger can store media in Amazon S3 — with no Composer needed on the server. Install it, activate it, then choose Amazon S3 in Settings → Media → Storage. Mutually exclusive with the Google Cloud and Azure SDK providers (one cloud SDK at a time).

review.notes: First-party provider module. Vendors aws/aws-sdk-php (Apache-2.0) as a release-asset bundle; ships no controllers/routes — its Bootstrap registers the bundled SDK autoloader, active-only. type:sdk. Mutually exclusive with the Google Cloud / Azure SDK providers via module.json "conflict".
